about: The words a clip's `setup` and `steps` may use (main/qa_clips.gd, client/README.md "Clips and tune"). Each word lists its arguments: a type (bool, number with min and max, rite, enemy) and whether it is required. The Discord agent's runner checks a clip request against the branch's copy of this file before it goes to a team PC, so a new word is an entry here, its handler in qa_clips.gd (SETUP_WORDS / STEP_WORDS) and a check in tests/qa_shots.gd; nothing in the runner.

hud.help: show the HUD while recording (it is hidden when this is left out)

stand_ins.help: the stand-in enemies: their kind, their health as a multiple of their normal health (400 when this is left out, so nothing dies) and whether they may hurt the hero (not when this is left out)

souls.help: the Reaper's souls when the recording starts (a full bag when this is left out); held to her bag's size

top_up.help: whether the hero's souls or essence are filled before each cast (they are when this is left out); off shows what a cast really costs

cast.help: cast a rite at `at` seconds into the clip, aimed at the stand-ins; a rite that is busy or cooling down is tried again each frame. A clip with cast steps casts nothing by itself
